name: Habit Assistant
description: Your personal habit and lightweight task companion with AI and team support.

ui.start_text:
👋 Welcome to Habit Assistant!

Build better habits, track your progress, manage lightweight tasks, and stay consistent with the help of AI.

🌱 Create and manage habits
📝 Create and manage tasks
💬 Add comments to tasks
📂 Organize tasks with categories
🔎 Search your tasks
🤖 Get help from AI
👥 Work with your team
📖 Learn how everything works

You can type your request or send a voice message.
ui.help_text:
📖 Habit Assistant Help

Habit Assistant supports habits plus a focused set of task-management features.

🌱 Habits — create, edit, track, and review habits
📝 Tasks — create, view, update, and complete your tasks
💬 Comments — add text, photos, voice messages, and files to tasks
📂 Categories — organize tasks without tags
🔎 Search — find tasks quickly
🤖 AI Assistant — create habits from natural language or voice and ask questions
👥 Teams — collaborate with other people
🎙️ Voice — describe a habit or task naturally and let AI process it

This bot does not provide task assignment or task templates.
ui.feature_intro: ✨ Habits first, plus the essential tools for lightweight task management.
